task.question: Which anime series won Anime of the Year at the 2026 Crunchyroll Anime Awards?
task.evidence: The eighth and final season of My Hero Academia won Anime of the Year award, the first concluding season of an anime series to win.

answer:
The second season of Jujutsu Kaisen won Anime of the Year at the 2026 Crunchyroll Anime Awards. 

FINAL: Jujutsu Kaisen

messages.content: [8th Crunchyroll Anime Awards] The 8th Crunchyroll Anime Awards were held at the Main Banquet Hall of the Grand Prince Hotel New Takanawa in Tokyo, Japan. This edition featured 32 categories honoring anime released from October 2022 to September 2023. The ceremony was streamed live by Crunchyroll on YouTube and Twitch. Sally Amaki and Jon Kabira hosted the ceremony for the second time, after doing so in the previous ceremony.

messages.content:
The Anime of the Year contenders include previous winners Jujutsu Kaisen, Attack on Titan, and Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba.
The second season of Jujutsu Kaisen won 11 awards, including Anime of the Year, which previously won in 2020, becoming the first anime to win multiple top prizes.
The second season of Jujutsu Kaisen winning 11 awards including Anime of the Year sparked a debate among critics and fans.
In a reflection piece after this year's edition, Animehunch opined that due to its design, the awards favor popularity over merit, noting that the second season of Vinland Saga was a far better recipient of Anime of the Year than the second season of Jujutsu Kaisen.

The second season of Jujutsu Kaisen won Anime of the Year at the 2026 Crunchyroll Anime Awards. 

FINAL: Jujutsu Kaisen
